tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind the stage and panels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the inspector and popovers. Text: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, the stage behind the 3D model, sheet previews.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections and rows. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and secondary buttons: 3:1 on surface, paper and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, units, captions on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: mat
tokens.usage: Brand and primary action: the one primary button per view, selection outlines, the active step. Text on it: on-mat.

tokens.name: on-mat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mat fill.

tokens.name: mat-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the selected row, the active segment and info notices. Text: ink.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: LED light only: bulbs, halos, the Light step, night mode. Never a button fill or text colour. Text on it: on-glow.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text on a glow fill (the lights counter).

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind lighting notices and the circuit card.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Chipboard: material swatches, Mimi, illustration. Never text.

tokens.name: basswood
tokens.usage: Basswood: material swatches and illustration. Never text.

tokens.name: score
tokens.usage: Score and fold lines on cut sheets and nets (dashed). 3:1 on surface-sunken and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states: calibrated, fits, export ready. Always with the check icon and a word. Text on surface and paper.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success notices. Text: ink.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look: thin joints, long cut times. Always with the alert icon and a word. Text on surface, paper and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning notices. Text: ink or warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocks a cut: overlaps, parts too big for the mat, unsupported blade; destructive actions. Always with an icon and a word. Text on surface, paper and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger notices and the clash fill on the floor plan. Text: ink or danger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Start screen and celebration moments only. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The kit name in the header and step titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Inspector heading (the selected thing), card and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside the inspector and panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Push a scrap of board into each slot.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Shelves come before the second side.
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints and captions under controls, in ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase section markers (set text-transform: uppercase in CSS). At most one per panel.

styles.name: measure
styles.usage: Every dimension, time and count: inputs with units, sheet sizes, LED leads. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Headline numbers in the kit meter and circuit card.

spacing.note: 4px base. Stack panels in space-5, rows in space-3, label-to-input space-1.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to input, icon to its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, inside compact controls, between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of fields; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; the stage gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of the inspector; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; between major regions.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Start-screen rhythm and the finger-joint pitch in illustrations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, segments, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, the stage, dialogs and the cut-sheet frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the checks pill, the step indicator, toasts.

shadow.note: Only things that float get a shadow. Panels sit on lines, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, the library drawer, toasts, the dragged piece.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Piece and sheet cards on hover.

layout.note: Fixed sizes of the app shell and controls.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, segments and chips inside panels.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: The header with the kit name and the step nav.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: The left tool rail.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: The library drawer when open.

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: The right inspector.
